verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is an AI accelerator platform with an official software stack, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a plausible capability. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint. The probes found no llms.txt, markdown docs or OpenAPI specs, so there is no evidence this capability exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
